subject: POC trial planning - RACI & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Claire O'Neill <claire.oneill@horizoncare.com>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, dylan.brooks@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: POC trial planning - RACI & next steps

Hi Claire —

Thanks again for a great call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before we kick off the trial: 

1) Proposed POC scope & timeline
- 4-week trial focused on ingesting 2 months of outpatient visit notes + real-time API calls for chart summarization.
- Week 0: Access, network setup, and service account provisioning
- Week 1: Data ingestion + baseline eval
- Week 2: Model tuning and latency checks
- Week 3: Business evaluation against success criteria

2) Success criteria (proposed)
- Avg latency for 512-token summary < 350ms p95
- Entity extraction F1 >= 0.86 on your labeled sample set
- <= 0.5% failure/errors for production request volumes in peak window
- Security/compliance sign-off for KMS + audit logs

3) RACI / ownership (draft)
- Responsible (R): HorizonCare app owner for data access and test cases
- Accountable (A): Marissa Cole (Redwood) for delivery and timeline
- Consulted (C): Redwood SE for infra setup (Dylan Brooks), Redwood Security for compliance (Neha Kapoor)
- Informed (I): HorizonCare procurement and platform teams

4) Immediate asks from your side
- Confirm infra owner and a technical point of contact for network/VPC (name + email)
- Confirm procurement contact for a short SOW and order of dedicated capacity
- Share a small sample of redacted notes (SFTP share or Drive link) for initial eval

Attachments: I attached a draft success criteria spreadsheet and our RACI template for your review (HorizonCare_POC_Success_Criteria.xlsx, RDW_Dedicated_RACI_Template_v2.xlsx).

If that looks good I can prepare a short mutual action plan and lock owners/times. Proposed: kickoff Tue 2026-07-20 (if your infra signoff completes this week).

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0192

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap and the templates. High-level confirmation from our side: the success criteria look reasonable. A few quick clarifications: 

- Infra: we currently run most workloads in our Azure VNet. For the trial we prefer Redwood Hosted with VPC peering; if that's not possible we'd evaluate a private deployment. Can you confirm network options and whether Redwood needs a service account or IP allowlist?
- Data access: we'll provide a redacted sample via SFTP. I'll share credentials with your SE.
- Procurement: looping in procurement for the order & SOW (cc'd) — they will need an estimated monthly commit and a short SOW.

I've put Procurement on copy — Michael Grant (IT Ops) will be the infra owner and will follow-up on network details (michael.grant@horizoncare.com).

Can you send the mutual action plan and the required info for our security/compliance team?

Best,
Claire O'Neill
Head of Product, HorizonCare
claire.oneill@horizoncare.com

Subject: Re: POC trial planning - RACI & next steps

Thanks Claire — great, appreciate the quick confirmation and for looping Michael/procurement in. A few follow-ups and clarifications from our side: 

Network & access options (short):
- Option A (recommended): Redwood Hosted with VPC peering (you provide peering + allowlist). Requires an environment IP allowlist and an RBAC service account for ingestion. No on-prem hardware required.
- Option B: Redwood Private (customer-managed VPC) if stricter isolation is needed — longer lead time (~2-3 weeks).

For the trial we can start on Option A to hit your timeline. Dylan (SE) — can you confirm the exact bits we need for peering (CIDR, preferred ports, expected egress)?

Draft RACI (updated with names):
- HorizonCare Infra Owner (R): Michael Grant <michael.grant@horizoncare.com>
- HorizonCare App Owner (R): Claire O'Neill (provides test cases)
- Redwood Account Lead (A): Marissa Cole (RDW)
- Redwood SE / Infra Setup (R): Dylan Brooks (dylan.brooks@redwood.ai)
- Redwood Security (C): Neha Kapoor (neha.kapoor@redwood.ai) — for KMS/audit logs checklist
- Procurement (I): HorizonCare Procurement (procurement@horizoncare.com)

Next steps I will take this afternoon:
- Draft mutual action plan (MAP) and share a short entry checklist for security/compliance
- Add estimated monthly commit and SOW template for Procurement to review

Claire — can you confirm Michael as the infra owner and share his preferred cadence (Slack/email) so Dylan can loop him in? Also confirm who will own test data preparation.

Thanks — I’ll send the MAP by EOD.

-Marissa

Marissa Cole | Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>

Subject: Internal: infra checklist for HorizonCare POC

Marissa —

Quick technical notes to include in the MAP / kickoff doc: 
- For VPC peering we need: peering CIDR, allowed egress (443/tcp, 22 for setup if requested), and an IP allowlist for the Redwood inference endpoints.
- Service account: Please have HorizonCare provision a service account (name: horizoncare-rdw-poc@horizoncare.org) with a key (we'll request temporary SA key for ingestion).
- Sample volumes: estimate peak 30 req/s and sustained ~8 req/s during business hours — allocate a 2-GPU dedicated slice for predictable latency (we can scale back if needed).
- Data format: newline-delimited JSON or S3/SFTP CSV with columns: patient_id (hashed), encounter_id, note_text, timestamp.

Attachment: infra_requirements.md (small checklist)

I'll be available for a technical sync Mon 2026-07-13 10am PT if Michael wants to join.

Thanks,
Dylan
